full_page.content:
Page 97
Aug. 8 Henry Cramer - 53 - threatened with T. B. and stomach trouble
8 Sharon Neumann - coming 3 - beautiful little girl - but sadly para- lized from birth. Unable to sit up or stand, can see or hear very little; is enrolled To-day again 1.00
Anthony Rojeski - 29 - very peculiar condition; has lost his voice - going down since March - Was enrolled last night, is here To-day "some improved - some of near relatives - "no Easter duty - promises
Page 98 Sep. 12 Wilbur Lightner - 22 - convulsions about every six weeks, baptized Catholic but never learned. His father had no religion. This young man went blind and was given up in Kiefer Hospital 14 yrs. ago, when his mother had a priest come in and anointed him. "I was dying" he said but shortly after improved and my sight became perfect.
Helen M. Varty - 49 - operated on several weeks ago for jandis - liver trouble, not doing very well ...
Leo Richer - 8 of Cleveland, O. - Hodgskins disease.
Elsie Wilder about 60 - Lutherine - married 25 years husband wants divorce.
Mary Sinnoman - 17 just graduated - serious leakage of heart - en- rolled To-day 5.
Page 99 Sep. 22 Mrs. Bertha Czanestke - 49 - had pneumonia last March and since has developed diabetis.
Leo Riker - 12 - cancer in both lungs; was enrolled May 28 - re- covered completely was home about four months. Now back in Hospital (St. Mary) since 28 of August with Hodgskins disease - Drs give no hope except prayer.
Rose LaBret - 38 - Jewish - nerveous break.
Cletus Lysinger - 51 - not Cathol. - after 26 yrs. taking up with someone else and wants to divorce wife.
